rationale.automation-bias: Synthesizes complacency, overtrust, deskilling, and missed AI errors.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Operationalizes effective oversight relevant to EU AI Act Articles 13–14.
rationale.lit-review: Conceptually synthesizes prior human-automation and AI-oversight research.
rationale.design-only: Specifies SDT measures and hypotheses without conducting empirical evaluation.
rationale.general-ai: Targets high-risk AI decisions broadly, not AI-generated code.
rationale.metrics: Defines sensitivity and response-bias measures for over-reliance and bias detection.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally analyzes trust, complacency, and automation-driven oversight failures.
rationale.risk-bias: Develops unfair-output detection using explicit fairness standards.
